title: Man Throws $80,000 Worth of Drugs Out of Car During High-Speed Chase
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On July 19, 2022, a deputy attempted to pull over a vehicle for a traffic violation in Fond Du Lac, WI. The vehicle refused to pull over and fled at a high rate of speed. During the pursuit, the deputy observed the suspect throw a white back from their vehicle. It was immediately recovered by the following deputy and was later discovered to be a significant amount of illegal drugs.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
